target.title: Root generated artifacts are absent
target.test: The repository should not keep stale root build output, Turbo cache, Yarn install cache, or runtime Docker volume contents as working tree artifacts after the monorepo migration.

steps.instruction: Inspect root generated paths after cleanup.
steps.expected: Root dist, .turbo, .yarn/install-state.gz, .yarn/unplugged, and non-.gitkeep docker/volume files are absent from the working tree.

target.passCriteria: Only required placeholders remain under docker/volume and no generated root artifact directories remain.

target.instruction: Inspect root generated paths after cleanup.
target.expected: Root dist, .turbo, .yarn/install-state.gz, .yarn/unplugged, and non-.gitkeep docker/volume files are absent from the working tree.

steps.descript: Generated root artifacts and runtime volume contents were absent after cleanup.
evidence: Command: for p in dist .turbo .yarn/install-state.gz .yarn/unplugged; do test ! -e "$p" && echo "absent $p"; done
Observed: absent dist, absent .turbo, absent .yarn/install-state.gz, absent .yarn/unplugged.
Command: find docker/volume -mindepth 2 -type f -o -type d | sort

steps.descript: Both Docker volume placeholders remain tracked.

result.descript: Only required placeholders remain under docker/volume and generated root artifacts were removed.
evidence: Root generated paths were absent before verification rebuild.
Docker volume contains only the two tracked .gitkeep placeholders.
